params.fromAccountId: Source account (id from list_accounts): null on an income.
params.toAccountId: Destination account (id from list_accounts): null on an expense.
params.currency: COP or USD; absent, the accounts' own.
params.counterAmountCents: What left or arrived, in cents, in the account of another currency.
params.counterIsEstimate: true while that second amount is an estimate, not what the bank billed.
params.occurredAt: Movement date, YYYY-MM-DD, never in the future.
params.description: Short text: merchant or concept; any note goes here too.
params.categoryId: Shortcut: one category (id from list_categories) for the whole amount.
params.splits: The movement's lines: each with categoryId, amountCents and optionally description (the product); the amounts sum to the movement's.
params.contributedByMemberId: «Whose»: the fund member; required on an income into a fund account.
params.forHousehold: true for a household expense paid from a personal account.
params.requestRef: REQUIRED. A UUID you generate per movement the person wants; on a retry reuse the same one and it never duplicates.
params.awaitingCounterparty: true when you do not know the other account (only on an expense or income, with one side): the movement waits for its counterparty. Use it instead of writing «unknown origin» in the description.
params.expectedUpdatedAt: The updatedAt list_movements returned; if someone edited it since, it is refused as stale.
params.limit: How many to return, 1 to 200; default 50.
params.accountKind: asset (bank, cash or receivable) or liability (card or loan: a card, a credit or a loan).
params.accountSubtype: bank, cash or receivable (money a person owes the household: «Owes me <person>»; only with kind asset), card or loan (a loan; only with kind liability).
params.openingBalanceCents: Opening balance in cents; on a card, what is owed, positive.
params.balanceOn: The date the opening balance is true as of, YYYY-MM-DD.
params.holderMemberId: Id of the fund member who holds the account, from list_members; null if it is everyone's.
params.parentAccountId: Id of the asset account this one is a pocket of, from list_accounts; null for an account of its own.
params.parentId: Parent category id of the same kind, or null.
params.categoryPlacement: personal or group; absent, the fund when the person has one.
params.color: A palette colour; absent, the first free one.
params.madeByMemberId: «Made by»: the fund member who made the movement (id from list_members). Only for a fund movement; null or absent is the household.
params.filterMadeByMemberId: Only movements made by this fund member (id from list_members), or "household" for the fund movements nobody made.
params.filterCategoryId: Only movements with a line in this category or one of its subcategories (id from list_categories).
params.offset: How many to skip, for paging; default 0.
params.relabelExpectedCount: How many movements transactionIds holds, as the person confirmed it; if it does not match the list of distinct ids, nothing is written.
params.relabelLabels: The labels (ids from list_labels or their names) each movement ends up with: they replace what it had; [] clears them; absent leaves them.
params.relabelCategoryId: The category (from list_categories) of each movement's single line; absent leaves what it had.
params.occurredAtDefault: Movement date, YYYY-MM-DD, never in the future. If you omit it, it is today in Bogotá.
params.occurredOnDefault: The entry's date, YYYY-MM-DD; today or earlier. If you omit it, it is today in Bogotá.
params.transactionIds: The ids (from list_movements) of 2 to 50 movements of one account and one kind, expense or income.
params.fromCategoryId: The category whose lines move (id from list_categories).
params.toCategoryId: The category that receives them, of the same kind (id from list_categories).
params.dryRun: true: write nothing and only return how many lines would move.
params.deliveries: The deliveries to accept, 1 to 50: each with its id and, optionally, the data that corrects or completes its proposal.
params.deliveryIds: The ids (from list_inbox) of 1 to 50 pending deliveries to reject.
params.memberDebtKind: debt for a new debt, payment for a repayment of an existing one.
params.debtorMemberId: The member who owes (an id from list_members).
params.creditorMemberId: The member who is owed (an id from list_members).
params.occurredOn: The entry's date, YYYY-MM-DD; today or earlier.
params.recipientId: The recipient id (from list_recipients); when saving, only to update an existing one.
params.recipientIdentifier: The number the message shows: account, phone or key, whole or its tail (e.g. 6870).
params.recipientName: What the person calls it, up to 80 characters.
params.recipientAccountId: own_account and person only: the account id (from list_accounts).
params.creditLiabilityAccountId: The credit someone else pays (liabilityAccountId from list_third_party_credits).
params.creditPersonName: Who pays the credit, 1 to 80 characters.
params.creditOpeningCents: Only with a new account: what the person owes today, in integer cents; by default what is left of the credit.
params.creditOpenedOn: Only with a new account: the day what they owe counts from, YYYY-MM-DD; today by default.
params.creditInstallmentCents: What the lender asks each month, in integer cents, above zero; null or empty, none.
params.creditDueDay: The day of the month the installment is due, 1 to 31; null or empty, none.
params.creditToAccountId: The person's account where the money arrived (id from list_accounts), other than the «owes me» one.
params.recipientCategoryId: payee only: the default category of its expenses (an id from list_categories).
params.labelName: The label's name, up to 80 characters.
params.labelPlacement: personal: one of the person's labels; group: the fund's (its leader only).
params.forPerson: Who the movement was for: the id of a person from list_persons, or their name. It stays the payer's own expense and creates no debt. Take that name out of the description. In update_movement absent keeps it and null removes it.
params.filterForPerson: Only movements for this person (an id from list_persons or their name), or «nobody» for those that name no one.
params.personName: The person's name, up to 80 characters.
params.chargeDefault: true only when the person said this one is charged; false (the default) is only the payer's own expense and charges nothing.
params.labelColor: A color from the category palette, such as #06B6D4. When absent, a free one is chosen.
params.labels: The movement's labels: ids from list_labels or their names. They must share the movement's scope (personal if it is personal, the fund's if it is the fund's). In update_movement it replaces the ones it had; absent keeps them and [] removes them.
params.filterLabel: Only movements with this label (an id from list_labels or its name).
params.debtAccountId: Id of the debt: a liability account from list_accounts or list_debts.
params.debtFromAccountId: The asset account the payment comes from (id from list_accounts).
params.debtKind: revolving (card or revolving limit) or installment (a credit paid in instalments).
params.annualRatePct: Effective annual rate as a percentage, as text: «24» or «28.5».
params.minimumPaymentCents: Fixed minimum payment, in cents; do not pass it with minimumPaymentPct.
params.minimumPaymentPct: Minimum payment as a percentage of the balance, text from 0 to 100 («5»); do not pass it with minimumPaymentCents.
params.statementCutOffDay: Day of the month of the statement cut-off, 1 to 31.
params.paymentDueDay: Day of the month the payment is due, 1 to 31.
params.scheduleRows: The rows of the bank's payment schedule, one per cuota in date order; they replace the schedule the loan already has.
params.scheduleDryRun: true: writes nothing and answers what the schedule would leave, read against the payments; call it so first and the person confirms.
params.scheduleDueOn: The day the cuota falls due, YYYY-MM-DD.
params.schedulePrincipalCents: The capital this cuota repays, in cents.
params.scheduleInterestCents: The interest of this cuota, in cents.
params.scheduleInsuranceCents: Insurance and other charges of this cuota, in cents; 0 if none.
params.scheduleTotalCents: The cuota total as the bank printed it, in cents; absent, it is the sum of capital, interest and insurance.
params.scheduleRemainingCents: The capital left once this cuota is paid, in cents; 0 on the last.
params.expectedCount: How many lines the person confirmed, the moved of the dryRun true call; required unless dryRun is true.
params.budgetArchived: true to list the archived budgets; by default, the active ones.
params.budgetAnchorDate: A day YYYY-MM-DD whose period is measured; today by default. Never a future one.
params.budgetCategoryId: The id of the budget's expense category (from list_categories).
params.budgetLimitCents: Limit in whole cents, in the budget's currency.
params.budgetThresholdPct: Percentage of the limit, 1 to 100, at which the budget warns.
params.budgetAccountId: The id of the account whose expenses it counts (from list_accounts); null for the whole category.
params.budgetLabel: A label, by id or by name (from list_labels), narrowing the movements it counts; null for none.
params.budgetName: Optional name; the category's when absent. null removes it.
params.goalArchived: true to list the archived goals; by default, the active ones.
params.goalName: The goal's name, up to 80 characters.
params.goalTargetAmountCents: The target, in whole cents, in the goal's currency.
params.goalTargetDate: The date it aims to be met, YYYY-MM-DD; null or absent when it has none.
params.goalAccountId: The id of the account whose currency and scope the goal takes (from list_accounts); null for none.
params.goalInitialContributionCents: A first contribution, in whole cents; optional.
params.goalContributionCents: The contribution, in whole cents, positive.
params.plannedStatus: pending, done or cancelled; all when absent.
params.plannedCategoryId: The id of the payment's category (from list_categories); null for none.
params.incomeAccountId: The account the income will land in (id from list_accounts).
params.incomeFrom: Who the income comes from, for example the client or the project.
params.incomeDueDate: The day it is expected, YYYY-MM-DD; may be future.
params.plannedDueDate: The due day, YYYY-MM-DD; may be future.
params.plannedRemindOn: The reminder day, YYYY-MM-DD, never after the due date; null for none.
params.recurringCategoryId: The id of the category of the movements it generates (from list_categories).
params.recurringIntervalN: Every how many periods of the frequency, at least 1; 1 by default.
params.recurringDayOfMonth: Day of the month 1 to 31; required for monthly and yearly, ignored for weekly.
params.recurringNextRunOn: The day the next movement is generated, YYYY-MM-DD.
params.recurringEndsOn: The last day it may be generated, YYYY-MM-DD, not before nextRunOn; null if it does not end.
params.silenceShape: true to reject and also silence this message shape: the next equal ones arrive already rejected and come back with restore_shape. false by default.
params.counterpartyAccountId: The account the movement lacks (id from list_accounts).
params.accountsArchived: true to list the archived accounts; by default, the open ones.
params.reconcileRealAmountCents: What the person counted, in whole cents and in the account's currency (for a debt, what is owed); negative if it fell below zero.
params.reconcileConfirmSignChange: true only when the person confirmed the count really has the opposite sign of the derived balance.
params.reconcileExpectedDerivedCents: The derivedCents get_reconcile_sheet (or the dryRun) returned for that same day; for a debt, what is owed, positive. Only the dryRun may omit it.

params.reconcileAccountsOn: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, no future; today if you omit it.

params.statementCutOffDate: The statement's cut-off date, YYYY-MM-DD; it does not repeat on one debt.
params.statementPaymentDueDate: Payment due date, YYYY-MM-DD; null if it has none.
params.statementClosingBalanceCents: Closing balance, what is owed, in whole cents.
params.statementCreditsCents: Payments and credits of the period, in cents; optional.
params.statementDebitsCents: Purchases and charges of the period, in cents; optional.
params.statementMinimumPaymentCents: The statement's minimum payment, in cents; optional.
params.billedCurrency: The currency the debt bills in (COP or USD).
params.billedCents: What the issuer billed, in whole cents, positive.
params.deferInstalments: The number of instalments the purchase is deferred into, the one the statement prints.

params.cardStatement: The closed statement as the PDF prints it.
params.cardTerms: The terms the statement prints; what is missing keeps what is stored.
params.cardAuthorizationNumber: The bank's authorization number for the deferral, as printed.
params.cardDeferralDescription: The deferral's description on the statement («AMPLIACION DE PLAZO», the merchant…).
params.cardSectionCurrency: Currency of the statement section it appears in, ISO code («COP», «USD»).
params.cardOriginalAmountCents: The original deferred amount, in whole cents of its currency.
params.cardCurrentInstalment: The instalment it is at, from 1 to the number of instalments.
params.cardMonthlyInstalmentCents: The monthly instalment, in whole cents.
params.cardPendingBalanceCents: What is still pending of the deferral, in whole cents.

params.cardPurchaseAmountCents: The purchase's amount, positive, in whole cents of the currency it was spent in.
params.cardPurchaseDescription: The purchase's description on the statement.
